_doc: Items that are neither ship components (components.json) nor raw materials (materials.json): ammo, crew gear and special finds. Content is data: add an entry here and recipes and cargo can name it. kind: ammo (spent by weapons that name it in their `ammo` field; `explosive: true` makes a wrecked ammo rack holding it blow up, data/ammo.json), gear (crew equipment, craftable) special (found, bought or earned only: it never has a recipe) or mod (a boarding mod, one item per tier, slot kit: worn in a kit slot, found or bought, never built; data/mods.json). Fuel is special: one jump of the Drift campaign burns one. `does` (optional) replaces the line the kind gives in the part description (data/describe.json items): the repair drone is gear that turns into a crew-like body aboard (Jobs.launch_drones).

items.name: Fuel
items.blurb: One jump's worth. Every Rusthold sells it by the can, and every can costs more than the last.

items.name: Rounds
items.blurb: Loose rounds for the hand weapons. Boarding parties never carry enough.

items.name: Missile
items.blurb: Slow, guided and loud about it. Artemis launchers eat these.

items.name: Pistol
items.blurb: Loud enough, reliable enough. The crew's first argument-settler.

items.name: Rifle
items.blurb: Longer reach, steadier hands. Boarding parties love it.

items.name: Basic Armour
items.blurb: Polymer plates stitched over a flight suit. Stops a bruise, not a bullet.

items.name: EVA Suit
items.blurb: Thin, pressurised and unfashionable. Lets a crew member breathe in a vented room.

items.name: Exosuit
items.blurb: A powered frame with servos and attitude. Found, never built.

items.name: Salamander Suit
items.blurb: Immune to fire, but slow. Strolls through the flames, unhurried.

items.name: Heat Suit
items.blurb: Insulated for hot rooms: work beside a Prism Core without cooking.

items.name: Slugthrower
items.blurb: A basalt heavy: slow, loud, and it does not ask twice. Found aboard, never built.

items.name: Plasma Rifle
items.blurb: A hand-held star. Turns up in locked crates and is never sold twice.

items.name: Repair Drone
items.does: Flies by itself: repairs, fights fires, reloads ammo.
items.blurb: One lens, one tool arm, no opinions. It works slower than a crew member, never mans a station, and when it breaks someone with a spanner can wake it again.

items.name: Spotter Cam Mk I
items.blurb: A shoulder camera that patches into the site's own. It sees what the dark would keep from you.
